title: Criterion for maximal algebraic degree
statement: Let $n$ be a positive integer and let $f:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{F}_2$. The algebraic degree of $f$ equals $n$ if and only if the coefficient of the monomial involving all $n$ coordinates in its algebraic normal form is nonzero.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional binary cube
